findings.evidence: run_assessment double-checks `assessment.candidate_scores` and `assessment.strategy_scores` against the trusted symbols/strategies sets after model_validate, but performs no equivalent `set(assessment.reasons).issubset(symbols | strategies)` check, even though _assessment_schema closes the `reasons` map over that same combined allowlist. Enforcement for reasons keys therefore relies solely on the external CLI's JSON-schema compliance, not a host-side boundary check like its siblings.
findings.proposal: Add `if not set(assessment.reasons).issubset(symbols | strategies): last_code = OUT_OF_ALLOWLIST; continue` alongside the existing two checks, for defense-in-depth parity. Low urgency: grep confirms Assessment.reasons is not read by quantpilot/paper/runtime.py or jobs.py (only candidate_scores/strategy_scores feed scoring), so a schema-noncompliant provider could at most attach a stray text label to an untracked key, not alter order/strategy authority.
